title: Wholesome Indian Chicken Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful Indian-inspired chicken tagine made with wholesome ingredients, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Stir in cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, and salt. Cook for 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes and chicken broth. Stir to combine.
Return chicken to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, covered, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, about 20-25 minutes.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
Serve hot over couscous or rice.
